data.change_summary: Reworked substrate redox state to distinguish legacy/uncomputed penetration from a valid 0 cm oxic boundary, compute a single shared O2 penetration depth across the full stacked substrate bed, expose canonical oxic/suboxic geometry and nutrient-availability accessors, route habitat surface/deep areas through the shared boundary, bump the save schema to v12 with a no-op migration, recompute missing legacy penetration values on load, and add regression coverage for anoxic water, stacked beds, shallow beds, nutrient partitioning, and save/load edge cases. Engine construction now only recomputes derived substrate zones for read-only-valid states so invalid inputs still preserve pre-simulation state for validation failures.
outstanding_risks: `cargo test -p tank_core` still emits an unrelated unused-import warning in `crates/tank_core/tests/source_water_carbonate.rs`; no functional test failures remain.

steps.description: Inspect the existing substrate zone, habitat, save/load, and test code to confirm the reported zero-penetration, stacked-boundary, and missing-API gaps.

Implement the substrate model and state-layer fixes: preserve valid 0 cm penetration, compute one cumulative stack boundary, add per-zone geometry/nutrient APIs, update habitat/save/load wiring, and adjust engine initialization behavior.
Add and update regression tests for anoxic water, stacked layers, shallow substrate, zone-depth and nutrient sums, and legacy/current save behavior, then run focused and full validation.
